What is your heightest education qualification ? Post Graduate Children Completed Help Center Additional Details View all chats with support Recommended Videos How to Top-Up your Wallet? Easily add money to your BOSPay wallet using UPI, debit card, credit card, or net banking. Go to Wallet → Top-Up, enter the amount, choose a payment method, and confirm. The amount will be instantly reflected in your wallet. How to Raise a Ticket? If you face any issue, you can raise a support ticket directly from the app. Go to Help & Support → Raise a Ticket, select the issue category, add details, and submit. Our support team will assist you shortly. How Cashback / Promo Codes Work on BOSPay? BOSPay offers cashback and promo codes on selected transactions. Apply the promo code during payment to avail instant discounts or cashback, which will be credited to your wallet as per the offer terms. How is a QR Code Generated? A unique QR code is automatically generated for secure and fast payments. Simply enter the amount and generate the QR code, which can be scanned to complete the transaction instantly. How to Cancel My Travel Bookings? You can cancel your travel bookings directly from the app. Go to My Bookings, select the booking you want to cancel, and follow the cancellation process. Refunds (if applicable) will be processed as per the policy. You can view all your past transactions in one place. Go to Transaction History to see detailed records of payments, wallet top-ups, refunds, and cashback. How to Check Transaction History?
